candidate_windows.window_text: The maximum sequence length is set to 16k. This setting is also held constant in baselines. We load the pre-trained InternLM2-7B model and train it with the following settings and hyper-parameters: the epoch is 1, the batch size is 2, the learning rate is 4e-5, and the AdamW optimizer is with a linear scheduler. We generate responses using sampling implemented via the LMDeploy library[17]. Our model is trained on 8 NVIDIA A800 GPUs. It takes approximately 1 hour to train.

We use InternLM2-7B and 20B as the base model for training.
